title: Prepare abstract-icon update without physical devices
outcome: Freeze WellSpent 0.2.0 (7), validate the exact candidate, and stage its App Store update while physical acceptance remains pending.

included: Allocate build 7, regenerate project and freeze exact source.
Run full CI and inspect signed archive and distribution export, privacy report and upload validation.
Capture candidate-source simulator store screenshots and stage accurate metadata and processed build in App Store Connect.
Record source, simulator, signed-package and external-service evidence separately; prepare remaining physical checklist.
excluded: Physical-device queries, installations, tests or data mutations.
App Review submission or public release before outstanding physical acceptance.
Tester invitations, external beta enrollment, public privacy/support copy changes, product behavior/schema/signing identity changes.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: A clean exact-source receipt identifies 0.2.0 (7) and generated-project parity.
Full thirteen-stage CI passes on the frozen candidate.
Signed archive and distribution export pass four-component inspection and include the approved abstract icon variants.
Accurate candidate-source screenshots, metadata and privacy reconciliation are ready, and App Store upload/processing status is recorded without claiming physical acceptance.
